# UnitedHealthcare

> > UnitedHealthcare provides health insurance plans, employer-sponsored benefits, ACA Marketplace coverage, and supplemental insurance products for individuals, families, and businesses.

UnitedHealthcare offers comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health services. The site serves brokers, employers, and individuals with plan information, policy updates, and resources for navigating insurance options through the ACA Marketplace and employer-sponsored programs.

## Key Topics

- UnitedHealthcare
- Affordable Care Act (ACA)
- ACA Marketplace
- Employer-sponsored plans
- Broker resources and announcements
- Specialty medical injectables and drug policies
- Dental and vision insurance
- Supplemental insurance
- HSA and HDHP requirements
- Behavioral health and mental health services
- Explanation of Benefits (EOB)
- Level Funded plans
- Whole-person health approach
- Network agreements and provider access
- Total cost of care benchmarks

## Health Insurance Plans & Coverage

- [North Carolina health insurance plans](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/north-carolina): North Carolina ACA Marketplace & individual health insurance options
- [South Dakota health insurance plans](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/south-dakota): South Dakota supplemental, dental, vision & mental health insurance
- [Combine dental, vision, medical Insurance](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/insurance-bundles): Insurance bundle strategies combining dental, vision & medical coverage
- [ACA plan navigators and assisters](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/aca-marketplace/aca-plan-navigators-assisters): ACA Marketplace navigator & assister training resources and state coverage
- [Explanation of benefits (EOB)](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/how-does-health-insurance-work/explanation-of-benefits): Understanding explanation of benefits (EOB) statements & claims
